pre_condition: proj_dir is a directory path; filepath is a path to a Python source file contained within proj_dir
post_condition: Returns a list of (name, start_idx, end_idx) tuples, one per top-level function defined in filepath, where start_idx and end_idx are 0-indexed inclusive line numbers bounding each function's body, if a CodeGraph index exists for proj_dir and covers the file. Returns None if CodeGraph is unavailable or the file is not indexed, signalling the caller to fall back to regex-based extraction
